subject: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge

Team —

Summary: VitalBridge (prospect -> strategic pilot) is asking for a short-term seat-swap plus a temporary surcharge waiver for months 1–3 while they ramp ingest. They want a 35% uplift off published starter rates in exchange for a 12-month committed pilot and a co-marketing mention. Sales recommends approving a one-off safeguard (seat-swap flexibility + surcharge waiver) to secure the commit; revenue ops flagged this as outside guardrails and asked for VP/CFO endorsement.

Why this matters: VitalBridge is a top-10 target in our pipeline for enterprise healthcare NLP — their POC will drive references into three accounts. The expected ARR if converted is $420k yr1; immediate ARR (if pilot converts to paid) is estimated at $120k. The risk is concession precedent; we propose scoped guardrails: limited to this deal, documented precedent note, and a 6-month rollback clause.

Recommendation (ask): Marissa/Marcus — please escalate for VP/CFO signoff to allow a one-off 35% effective discount plate on the starter bundle for months 1–3, waive the onboarding surcharge for the pilot, and permit seat-swap (up to 20% of seats) during ramp. Require signature on SOW v3 and include an explicit clause that the pricing triggers revert at month 4 if usage metrics are not met.

Attachments referenced: VL-Statement-usage.xlsx (customer projected token usage), SOW-v3.pdf (updated commercial terms), redwood-term-sheet.docx (for legal).

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Account Strategist | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge

Irene — thanks for the write-up. A few quick datapoints:
- Net new ARR expected: $420k (conservative).
- Upside: enterprise conversion to multi-region Dedicated later in year 2.
- Customer asks specifically: waive the $10k onboarding surcharge and allow seat reallocation for their initial user cohort.

From a commercial-risk perspective I support the ask if we bake in: 1) explicit timebox (3 months), 2) defined usage thresholds (see row 'must-hit' in VL-Statement-usage.xlsx), and 3) executive review at month 2.

Please escalate to Markus for CFO alignment; Jordan — please prep a short precedent memo that we can file in commercial exceptions.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge

Quick finance note: a 35% effective discount on the starter bundle for 3 months reduces our gross margin on the pilot by ~22% for that period. If the pilot converts, we sharply regain margin under published recurring rates. Recommend: 1) require a refundable onboarding deposit ($15k) payable on DocuSign signature (to offset early concession), or 2) if we waive deposit, require a clear termination penalty in the SOW.

Either option mitigates churn risk. Also flagged: contract needs a one-off clause avoiding auto-application of discount to future renewals.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge

Attached is a 1-page precedent brief (attached inline) summarizing comparable one-off scope in 'Edgebridge' and 'CardioPulse' pilots — the ask is materially similar and we documented rollback clauses. I redlined SOW v3 to include: 1) pilot pricing table (explicit 3-month discount), 2) termination penalty section, and 3) automatic reversion to published rates at month 4.

I also added the clause Marcus requested for deposit/termination penalty. If Marissa and Marcus confirm, I'll push to DocuSign.

Jordan Blake
Commercial Contracts Lead | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CFO endorsement for one-off safeguard & seat-swap concession - VitalBridge

Reviewed — I approve the one-off concession under the conditions below:
1) 35% effective discount limited to months 1–3 on the starter bundle only.
2) Onboarding surcharge waived for the pilot; customer to pay $15k refundable deposit at signing (deposit released after month 3 if usage thresholds met).
3) Seat-swap allowed up to 20% of initial seats for months 1–3; reallocation must be logged and reported weekly.
4) SOW must include a 'no-precedent' clause preventing any automatic replication to future deals; Legal to add a precedent memo reference.
5) Jordan to file exception memo in the commercial exceptions tracker and link to Deal RDW-2026-0073.

Marissa — please confirm commercial ops will add the exception memo and set a month-2 executive check-in with Corporate Customer Success. Once confirmed, Jordan can send for signature.

-MK
Markus Klein
CFO | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@vitalbridge.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, procurement@vitalbridge.ai

Irene — appreciate the quick work. VitalBridge signs up to the deposit and the rollout plan. Can you send the final DocuSign bundle this morning? Procurement will countersign.
